Priya M.: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands on release cadence and oncall. Can we capture the outcomes here?
Sam H.: Short version: recommend a 3-week planning rhythm as the default to reduce mid-sprint churn. Not mandatory  teams can keep 2/4 weeks with a short note on tradeoffs.
Noah B.: If teams move to 3 weeks, will oncall schedules change?
Sam H.: Primary oncall -> 7-day rotations (MonSun) to cut handovers. Secondaries unchanged.
Rina C.: Any change to paging SLAs?
Sam H.: Paging rules unchanged: sev1 pages immediate; ack target 15m; mitigation plan target 30m. Were adding explicit checklist items to runbooks for 15/30.
Ken P.: Canary / rollout template we agreed?
Sam H.: Agreed default template (teams may tweak): stages = [10,50,100], health metrics = p95_latency, error_rate, quality_regressions, auto-promote = 3 green checks.
Noah B.: CI auto-promote behavior?
Sam H.: CI will auto-promote after 3 consecutive green evaluations and 15m with no new errors. Ops can abort from the deploy dashboard.
Rina C.: Who owns runbook and post-release checklist updates?
Noah B.: I can own runbook edits. Rina will own post-release checklist and eval sets.
Priya M.: Action items: Sam to add template to infra repo, Noah to refresh runbooks, Rina to publish eval sets, Ken to update SLA copy. Please drop PR links in #eng-process. :thumbsup:

Priya M.: Thanks all  leadership will check progress next week.
